title: Juicy American Salmon Slider
description: Savory and pillowy sliders featuring pan-seared salmon fillets, crispy slaw, and creamy sauce, all sandwiched between soft buns.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together buttermilk, mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, hot sauce, salt, and black pepper to make the sauce.
Place the salmon fillets in a separate bowl and pour the buttermilk mixture over them. Let it marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the salmon from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Add 1-2 tbsp of oil to the skillet and sear the salmon for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the salmon is cooking, toast the buns on the grill or in a toaster.
To assemble the sliders, place a cooked salmon fillet on each bun, followed by a dollop of coleslaw and a drizzle of the buttermilk sauce.
Top with the top bun and serve immediately.
Serve with additional sauce on the side for dipping, if desired.
